oracle.name: Dataverse Web API (hosted environment)
oracle.scope: Two hosted runs on 2026-11-26 (run-derived-A/B) of thirteen designer rollup columns exported from the Power Apps rollup designer shapes (Count, Sum, Average, Minimum, Maximum, a NotNull filter, option-set and Boolean Equal and Decimal GreaterThan filters, a hierarchical Sum and Count) over an invented parent and child schema with a P1, P2, P3 hierarchy and an empty P4. Establishes the stored values and states after seeding, the CalculateRollupField value and state (a null value absent), an ignored direct write and a recalculation after a child update; dates and response annotations are not recorded.
